caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a drinking vessel or horn, mounted on a rectangular stone base. The vessel is shaped like a large, curved horn with a wide, rounded opening at the top, colored in rich, dark red with areas of lighter reddish highlights, giving it a glossy appearance. The narrow end of the horn leads into a realistic sculpted hand, adorned with gold and bronze decorative bands featuring engraved patterns, some with geometric shapes and zigzag lines. The hand is detailed with defined fingers and fingernails, and its coloration includes shades of bronze and gold. The entire horn-hand object is positioned diagonally across the pale beige stone base, which has sharp edges and facets, with some subtle gray and yellowish shading to indicate depth and texture. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Ruby Vase
